repos_data.description: MCP server and API examples for OpenEphemeris — NASA JPL ephemeris API for AI agents

Rust ephemeris and Vedic astrology (Jyotish) engine for kundli/kundali, panchanga, dashas and vargas, accurate to 0.096″ mean vs JPL Horizons. Python, WebAssembly and 17 MCP tools for AI agents. Clean-room, source-available (BUSL-1.1), no AGPL obligations.
Precision-audited astrology MCP for AI agents — natal charts, transits, synastry & moon phases. Local-first, no API key, no account.
